summary: Projects Product List UX Reframe. Bounded low-risk presentation-only redesign based on the approved Linear Projects primary reference with Vercel/GitHub supporting patterns: remove the three-column table feel, make project identity the primary scan target, collapse historical projects by default, move lifecycle state into a quiet action rail, suppress routine health/activity metadata on healthy current rows, replace KPI-card repetition with a compact inline summary, and add compact project identity marks. Shared Shell/Navigation, schema, canonical data, Git/source authority, lifecycle semantics, attention/repair behavior, auth/security and updater mechanism are unchanged. OWNER explicitly instructed UX/UI optimization and previously required publish before reporting; OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies. OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Release-gate reconciliation updated only superseded presentation contracts and focused test literals; product behavior is unchanged. Production remains Owner manual and this release request must not write Production data.
